mapper.select:
SELECT B.BOARD_ID, B.TITLE, B.WRITER, B.REG_DT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_FILE F WHERE F.BOARD_ID = B.BOARD_ID) AS FILE_CNT FROM BOARD B
ORDER BY B.BOARD_ID DESC LIMIT #{recordCountPerPage} OFFSET #{firstIndex}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD (BOARD_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, WRITER, REG_DT) VALUES (#{boardId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{writer}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT FILE_ID, BOARD_ID, ORIGINAL_NAME, STORED_NAME, FILE_SIZE, CONTENT_TYPE, REG_DT FROM BOARD_FILE WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId} ORDER BY FILE_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD_FILE (BOARD_ID, ORIGINAL_NAME, STORED_NAME, FILE_SIZE, CONTENT_TYPE, REG_DT) VALUES (#{boardId}, #{originalName}, #{storedName}, #{fileSize}, #{contentType}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
